description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (3000)], [Last Stand], [Haste], [Stoneskin: 30%], [High Quick Cast 2], grants [Awoken Sketch] to the user

description.name: HP Stock (3000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 3000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Stoneskin: 30%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 30% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Awoken Sketch
description.text: White Magic and Support abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for White Magic and Support abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, grants [HP Stock (500)]/[HP Stock (1000)]/[HP Stock (1500)]/[HP Stock (2000)]/[HP Stock (3000)] to all allies after using a White Magic or Support ability
